question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dept_tip_library_integration AS
WITH tip AS (
  SELECT 
    d.tip_subject_offered_key,
    d.term_code,
    d.subject_id,
    d.tip_material_key,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.isbn), ''), m.isbn) AS isbn,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(m.title), ''), NULL) AS title,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(m.author), ''), NULL) AS author
  FROM beaver."tip_detail" d
  LEFT JOIN beaver."tip_material" m
    ON d.tip_material_key = m.tip_material_key
), dept AS (
  SELECT tso.tip_subject_offered_key, tso.offer_dept_name
  FROM beaver."tip_subject_offered" tso
), lib AS (
  SELECT 
    lmd.term_code,
    lmd.subject_id,
    lmd.library_course_instructor_key,
    lmd.library_reserve_catalog_key
  FROM beaver."library_reserve_matrl_detail" lmd
), cat AS (
  SELECT 
    lrc.library_reserve_catalog_key,
    lrc.catalog_isbn,
    lrc.catalog_title,
    lrc.catalog_author_name
  FROM beaver."library_reserve_catalog" lrc
), instr AS (
  SELECT 
    lci.library_course_instructor_key,
    lci.instructor_name
  FROM beaver."library_course_instructor" lci
), subj_dept AS (
  SELECT 
    s.subject_id,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(cc.department_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(dc.department_name), '')
    ) AS department_name
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM beaver."tip_detail" WHERE subject_id IS NOT NULL
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN beaver."cis_course_catalog" cc
    ON cc.subject_id = s.subject_id
  LEFT JOIN beaver."drupal_course_catalog" dc
    ON dc.subject_id = s.subject_id
)
SELECT 
  sd.department_name,
  dpt.offer_dept_name,
  t.subject_id,
  t.term_code,
  t.tip_material_key,
  t.isbn,
  t.title,
  t.author,
  lib.library_reserve_catalog_key,
  cat.catalog_isbn,
  cat.catalog_title,
  cat.catalog_author_name,
  CASE WHEN cat.library_reserve_catalog_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS available_in_library_flag,
  lib.library_course_instructor_key,
  instr.instructor_name
FROM tip t
LEFT JOIN dept dpt
  ON t.tip_subject_offered_key = dpt.tip_subject_offered_key
LEFT JOIN lib 
  ON lib.subject_id = t.subject_id AND lib.term_code = t.term_code
LEFT JOIN cat
  ON cat.library_reserve_catalog_key = lib.library_reserve_catalog_key
LEFT JOIN instr
  ON instr.library_course_instructor_key = lib.library_course_instructor_key
LEFT JOIN subj_dept sd
  ON sd.subject_id = t.subject_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base_enriched AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(offer_dept_name, department_name) AS department,
        term_code,
        -- Prefer TIP material fields; fallback to catalog when missing
        COALESCE(title, catalog_title) AS tip_title,
        COALESCE(author, catalog_author_name) AS tip_author,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(isbn,''), NULLIF(catalog_isbn,'')) AS isbn_norm,
        CASE WHEN available_in_library_flag = 'Y' THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS library_availability,
        library_course_instructor_key,
        instructor_name
    FROM dept_tip_library_integration
), per_book_instructors AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        tip_title,
        tip_author,
        isbn_norm,
        term_code,
        library_availability,
        COUNT(DISTINCT instructor_name) AS total_instructors_per_book
    FROM base_enriched
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
), dept_avail_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        SUM(CASE WHEN library_availability = 'Available in Library' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_materials_available_in_library
    FROM per_book_instructors
    GROUP BY 1
), grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_materials_available_in_library) AS total_available_materials_all_departments FROM dept_avail_counts
)
SELECT 
    p.department AS department_name,
    p.tip_title AS title,
    p.tip_author AS author,
    p.isbn_norm AS isbn,
    p.term_code AS library_term_code,
    p.library_availability AS availability_label,
    p.total_instructors_per_book,
    d.total_materials_available_in_library,
    g.total_available_materials_all_departments
FROM per_book_instructors p
LEFT JOIN dept_avail_counts d ON p.department = d.department
CROSS JOIN grand_total g
ORDER BY department_name, title
LIMIT 200

# Create aggregated results per department with required totals and availability labeling

# We compute per department and book (by ISBN/title/author) the instructor count, availability flag, and include term code.
import pandas as pd

# Base integrated table name
base = "dept_tip_library_integration"

# Build availability label
avail_sql = f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base_enriched AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(offer_dept_name, department_name) AS department,
        term_code,
        -- Prefer TIP material fields; fallback to catalog when missing
        COALESCE(title, catalog_title) AS tip_title,
        COALESCE(author, catalog_author_name) AS tip_author,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(isbn,''), NULLIF(catalog_isbn,'')) AS isbn_norm,
        CASE WHEN available_in_library_flag = 'Y' THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS library_availability,
        library_course_instructor_key,
        instructor_name
    FROM {base}
), per_book_instructors AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        tip_title,
        tip_author,
        isbn_norm,
        term_code,
        library_availability,
        COUNT(DISTINCT instructor_name) AS total_instructors_per_book
    FROM base_enriched
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
), dept_avail_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        SUM(CASE WHEN library_availability = 'Available in Library' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_materials_available_in_library
    FROM per_book_instructors
    GROUP BY 1
), grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_materials_available_in_library) AS total_available_materials_all_departments FROM dept_avail_counts
)
SELECT 
    p.department AS department_name,
    p.tip_title AS title,
    p.tip_author AS author,
    p.isbn_norm AS isbn,
    p.term_code AS library_term_code,
    p.library_availability AS availability_label,
    p.total_instructors_per_book,
    d.total_materials_available_in_library,
    g.total_available_materials_all_departments
FROM per_book_instructors p
LEFT JOIN dept_avail_counts d ON p.department = d.department
CROSS JOIN grand_total g
ORDER BY department_name, title
LIMIT 200
"""
